text:
alex: Starting overnight quant kernel deploy (kernel-q v7.3) into night buckets. Strategy: staggered slices 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 12m holds. Target window 23:30-04:00 PT. tagging @oncall and @release

maria: Please confirm rollback gates and pin behaviour. Last time we saw slow memory leak after 40m on canary.

sam: Rollback triggers: p95 > baseline +50ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows OR error-rate > 0.2% OR OOM events > 0 on any canary host. Also abort if kv_cache_hit drops > 10% vs baseline. If triggered, deploybot should pin previous kernel-q:v7.2 with sticky TTL 36h.

jen: Evalset used for smoke is quant_smoke_v3 (s3://redwood-evals/quant_smoke_v3). We'll run the scripted regression check:
```
python tools/eval_smoke.py --model kernel-q:v7.3 --batch 16 --dataset quant_smoke_v3 --metrics top1,latency
```

deploybot: Rollout initiated: kernel-q:v7.3 slice=0.05 state=progressing

opsbot: Canary snapshot @0.05: p95=142ms (baseline 130ms), cpu=38%, kv_cache_hit=0.92, oom=0

maria: p95 ok so far but still within warmup. what's seq length distribution?

alex: Canary traffic includes 512 and 1024 tail traffic to validate kv paths. We'll watch next 12m.

sam: If p95 doesn't improve >10ms after 12m, abort to v7.2 and file postmortem.

jen: Release notes draft up: https://github.com/redwood/releasepad/pull/432 : includes quantization note about A100 BF16 variance and improved matmul kernel.

opsbot: slice=0.20 state=progressing

opsbot: Canary snapshot @0.20: p95=135ms, cpu=41%, kv_cache_hit=0.90

maria: Good. moving to 60%

alex: Reminder: run KV cache priming job in parallel to avoid cold-cache bias (run: tools/prime_kv.sh us-west-night).

sam: Also watch host swap metrics for thermal throttling — drivers changed. If thermal throttling > 3% on any host, abort.

opsbot: slice=0.60 state=progressing

opsbot: Canary snapshot @0.60: p95=170ms (spike), cpu=46%, kv_cache_hit=0.88

maria: Spiking. Is that correlated with prime job?

alex: Looks like spike coincided with priming job. pausing rollout for 12m hold to see baseline settle.

sam: Agree. If p95 remains > baseline+40ms after 12m, we abort and pin v7.2.

deploybot: Rollout paused by alex: reason=observed-spike hold=12m

opsbot: 6m into hold: p95=150ms, cpu=44%, kv_cache_hit=0.87

maria: trending down. keep monitoring

opsbot: end of hold: p95=138ms, cpu=43%, kv_cache_hit=0.89

alex: Looks stable. proceeding to 100% in two minutes.

deploybot: slice=1.00 state=progressing

opsbot: post-deploy snapshot: p95=132ms, cpu=42%, kv_cache_hit=0.90

sam: All gates passed. removing sticky pin plan. Nate, confirm TTL behavior?

nate: We'll not pin by default. If rollback occurs, pin v7.2 for 36h. Otherwise no pin.

jen: Release notes merged. tagging #release and docs. Link: https://github.com/redwood/releasepad/commit/abc123 :memo:

maria: Post-deploy: watch for 6h, if any anomalous memory growth or error-rate jumps, escalate.

alex: Thanks team. Nice safe rollout. :thumbsup:
